content.title: [Brand] Portable Smoothie Blender 350ml Tritan Cup, USB-C Rechargeable
bullets: BLEND ANYWHERE: This compact personal blender holds 350 ml (about 11.8 oz), enough for a single smoothie, protein shake, or juice. It fits easily in a gym bag, backpack, or desk drawer, so you can blend at work, at the gym, or on the road.

USB-C CHARGING: The built-in 2000mAh rechargeable battery charges through USB-C, so you can use the same cable as many phones and laptops. Plug it into a wall adapter, power bank, or computer and skip the extra charger.

ABOUT 12 BLENDS PER CHARGE: In-house factory testing showed about 12 blending cycles on a full charge. Your results may vary with ingredients and usage, but one charge can cover several days of morning shakes.

ONE-BUTTON OPERATION: There are no settings to fiddle with. Add your ingredients, press the single button, and the 6 stainless steel blades blend your drink. The cup doubles as your drinking cup, so there is less to wash afterward.
SAFETY LOCK WHEN DETACHED: The blender will not run when the cup is separated from the base. This helps prevent accidental starts while you are filling, emptying, or cleaning it.
content.description:
Make fresh smoothies, shakes, and juices wherever your day takes you. This portable blender pairs a 350 ml Tritan cup with 6 stainless steel blades and a 2000mAh rechargeable battery, so you can blend a single serving without a full-size countertop appliance.

It is easy to use. Charge it with any USB-C cable, add your ingredients, and press the one button to start. In-house factory testing showed about 12 blends per full charge; actual results depend on what you blend and how long you run it. A built-in safety lock keeps the motor from running when the cup is detached from the base.

Its compact size works for the office, gym, travel, and dorm rooms. Blend, then drink straight from the cup and rinse.

findings.problem_zh: 商品页没有任何加州 65 号提案警示，也没有标明 WARNING 的链接。供应商资料未说明本品是否需要该警示。产品含电机、电池、线路等电子部件，可能涉及需警示的化学物质，需要人工确认。
findings.suggestion_zh: 请向工厂索取材料成分或第三方检测资料（如电线、PCB、塑料件中的铅、邻苯二甲酸酯等），确认是否需要 65 号提案警示。如需要，在商品页加入完整警示：WARNING:、具体化学物质名称、危害类型（致癌或生殖毒性）以及 www.P65Warnings.ca.gov；也可加一个用 WARNING 字样标明的链接。如确认不需要，请留存依据。不得在没有资料的情况下自行填写化学物质。

content.hook: ¿Licuado en la oficina sin cargar la licuadora grandota? Mira esto 👀

script.shot_zh: 创作者在办公桌前，从包里拿出榨汁杯，镜头特写杯身大小
script.line: Este vasito es una licuadora portátil de 350 mililitros, cabe en la mochila sin bronca.

script.shot_zh: 往杯里放切好的水果和一点牛奶，特写杯底的刀头
script.line: Le echas tu fruta, tu leche, y abajo trae seis cuchillas de acero inoxidable.

script.shot_zh: 手指按下唯一的按钮，杯子开始搅拌，镜头跟拍
script.line: Le picas a un solo botón y listo, ni le tienes que andar moviendo a nada.

script.shot_zh: 把杯体从底座拧下来，再按按钮，机器不启动，创作者对镜头点头
script.line: Y si quitas el vaso, se desactiva solito. Así no arranca cuando no debe.

script.shot_zh: 插上 USB-C 线充电，然后举杯喝一口，对镜头微笑
script.line: Se carga con USB-C y, según pruebas de fábrica, te rinde como 12 licuados por carga. ¡Salud!

content.caption: Mi nuevo compa para los licuados de la mañana 🥤 Vaso de 350 ml, un solo botón, 6 cuchillas de acero inoxidable y carga USB-C. Si quitas el vaso, se desactiva solito. Rinde alrededor de 12 licuados por carga (prueba interna de fábrica). Lo encuentras aquí en TikTok Shop 🛒
content.notes_zh: 用墨西哥口语（sin bronca、le picas、compa）写日常办公场景，只用资料里的卖点；'约12次'注明为工厂内部测试，不提 BPA-free（只有供应商声明，没有成品报告），不提 NOM/UL 等认证；产品是电池+USB-C 充电，没有 127V 额定电压的数据，所以文案里没写电压，以免写出不实参数。
